thread:
Maya: Async pulse — quick check-in for the runtime perf sprint. Drop blockers, PRs, and canary windows here. TL;DR: kernel PR needs review, KV cache warmup still spikes tail, and test infra might block Wed canary.

Ryan: Kernel PR #487 is ready for review — micro-kernel scheduler tweak + tighter prefetch boundaries. Local perf +6–8% throughput on our 128/256 tests, but I saw a regression at seq=512 on one config. @Maya logging the failing case.

Priya: KV warmup numbers from yesterday: cold-start rate went from 12% -> ~4% after a 30s warmup window, but we still see a 95th/99th latency spike in the first 3 tokens for warm hosts. Graph uploaded: https://internal/graphs/kv-warmup-1716 (will add to ops ticket). Planning: try extending prefetch from 1s -> 5s for high-QPS routes and measure.

Sam: Question — can we coordinate a canary that includes both the kernel change and the new warmup policy? I can reserve a dedicated slot Wed 9–11 PT, but we need a KV snapshot export before the deploy to roll back cleanly.

Jess: Heads up — test infra is flaky after the latest base image. Seeing repeated failures on GPU nodes:
```
[2024-05-22T02:14:03Z] ERROR nv_shmem_init failed: -22
[2024-05-22T02:14:03Z] NodeReporter: gpu0 unavailable, draining
```
Bisecting now, could block Wed canary if I don't root-cause by EOD.

Ryan: If infra blocks, we can run a CPU-only microbench to validate correctness and perf delta, though it's less representative for latencies. Also pinging Eng-ML about quantized kernel compatibility — @Priya can you take that sync?

Priya: @Ryan — will sync with Eng-ML today and add compatibility tests to the PR. I'll also open the ops ticket to request the longer warmup policy and tag affected routes (high-qps).

Maya: Action items: Ryan — get PR green and add a perf regression test for seq=512. Jess — finish infra bisect by EOD and post findings. Sam — book the canary slot and prepare KV snapshot export, fallback to Thu if blocked. Priya — open ops ticket + Eng-ML sync. I'll follow up in the morning with a short standup note. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: canary-checker: Sam booked slot 2024-05-22T16:00Z for runtime-canary (auto-confirmed).

Sam: Noted. If infra still flaky, I'll move the slot to our dedicated pre-prod cluster and update here.

Maya: Thanks team — drop quick updates here as you make progress, especially any changed deploy times or new blockers.
